findings.issue: All error paths pass through sanitize_error_message before writing to DB. No raw exception messages written directly.

Cohort-level exception handler writes no error message — only updates status. If the exception contains sensitive data (e.g. from criteria_loader FileNotFoundError with a path), it's silently dropped. This is actually safe from a data-leak perspective but means cohort failures are silent.
findings.suggestion: Log exceptions with a sanitized message at cohort level for operability.
